form.joinNotice: By joining you get emails about your place on the waitlist and our launch; you can stop them any time from the link in each email. We handle your data as our <link>Privacy Policy</link> describes.
form.noteConsent: Also note which button or campaign link brought me here. It helps us see which links work; you can remove it any time from the link in our emails or by writing to us.

deletion.confirmBody: This deletes your waitlist entry and the records tied to your email address. It cannot be undone. Security logs (up to 90 days), database backups (within a day) and our email provider's own copies stay for a time, and an invite code your friends joined with stays on their entries.
deletion.successBody: We deleted your waitlist entry, your email records and your deletion links. Some records stay for a time: security logs with your IP address for up to 90 days, database backups until they clear within a day, and our email provider's own copies under its retention rules. If friends joined with your invite code, it stays on their entries.
deletion.nothingFoundBody: We found no waitlist entry for this email address. The email records and deletion links tied to it are deleted.
deletion.expiredBody: This deletion link has expired. Please submit a new deletion request.
deletion.errorBody: We couldn't process your request. Please try again or contact support.
